wildOasis.title: The Wild Oasis (Client Version)
wildOasis.desc: The Wild Oasis is the client-side version of a hotel management application. Users can register, search for available rooms, and make reservations for their preferred dates.

wildOasisAdmin.title: The Wild Oasis (Internal Management Version)
wildOasisAdmin.desc: The Wild Oasis is an internal hotel management application where users can register, view hotel statistics, add rooms, check room status, and switch themes.
wildOasisAdmin.result: Admin panel with stats and room status

natours.title: Natours
natours.desc: Natours is a stylish, responsive single-page website showcasing adventure tours. Users can explore various options for adventure vacations.

panenco.title: Software engineer
panenco.desc: Currently working at Panenco as a Software engineer, developing the product and working across the frontend and backend parts of the application.

developsToday.title: Front-end Developer
developsToday.desc: Owned the product's frontend: project structure, UI architecture and key technical decisions. Next.js, React Query and Zustand, shadcn/ui, Supabase and search on Typesense.

bettorFaster.title: Junior Front-end Developer
bettorFaster.desc: Built and maintained 30+ reusable React components, cutting code duplication by 15%. Sped up loading, set up state with Zustand and React Query, and brought test coverage to 90%+.

plan.title: Tailored Planning & Strategy
plan.desc: I carefully analyze the needs of each project, considering both business goals and user experience. Together, we'll define clear objectives and a roadmap to ensure a well-structured, user-friendly project.

build.title: Efficient Development & Transparent Communication
build.desc: Throughout the development process, I prioritize clean, scalable code while keeping you informed with regular progress updates, ensuring transparency and collaboration every step of the way.

launch.title: Final Testing & Seamless Launch
launch.desc: Before launching, I rigorously test the website for performance, responsiveness, and compatibility across all devices. I ensure a smooth, hassle-free launch, leaving you with a fully functional and professional project.

Contact.title: Let's talk?
Contact.body: If you have work that needs someone equally comfortable in React and in the API layer, get in touch. Tell me what you are building and where it currently hurts.
Contact.respond: I usually reply within a day.
Contact.reachOut: Explore my resume to learn more about my skills and experience, and reach out to discuss how I can help you achieve your creative goals.
